main.label: 样本内语料（50 条）

results.question: 客户总数是多少
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c LIMIT 10

results.question: C4 风险等级的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.risk_level = 'C4' LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户的平均年龄是多少
results.sql: SELECT AVG(c.age) AS 平均年龄 FROM cust_info c LIMIT 10

results.question: 高净值客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' LIMIT 10

results.question: 活跃客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) LIMIT 10

results.question: 沉默客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_cashflow WHERE flow_type = '流入' AND flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) LIMIT 10

results.question: 在售产品一共有多少只
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 产品数 FROM prod_info p LIMIT 10

results.question: 风险等级 R5 的产品有几只
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 产品数 FROM prod_info p WHERE p.risk_level = 5 LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户总资产合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) AS 总资产合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户日均资产合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(a.daily_avg_asset) AS 日均资产合计, SUM(a.total_asset) AS 总资产合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户的平均总资产是多少
results.sql: SELECT AVG(a.total_asset) AS 平均总资产 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 持仓市值合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 持仓记录一共有多少笔
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 持仓笔数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户经理一共有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.mgr_id) AS 客户经理数 FROM mgr_info m LIMIT 10

results.question: 交易记录一共有多少笔
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_trade t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 资金流水一共有多少条
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 流水条数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_cashflow f ON c.cust_id = f.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 持仓的平均收益率是多少
results.sql: SELECT AVG(h.profit_ratio) AS 平均收益率 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 客户持仓的总成本是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.cost_value) AS 持仓成本合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id LIMIT 10

results.question: 持有科技成长组合的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' LIMIT 10

results.question: 持有新能源主题基金的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '新能源主题基金' LIMIT 10

results.question: 持有高风险产品（R4 及以上）的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.risk_level >= 4 LIMIT 10

results.question: 高净值客户的持仓市值合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' LIMIT 10

results.question: C5 客户的持仓市值合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.risk_level = 'C5' LIMIT 10

results.question: 持有科技成长组合的客户总资产是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.m0) AS 总资产合计 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS cust_id, (SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) FROM cust_asset a WHERE a.cust_id = c.cust_id) AS m0 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' GROUP BY c.cust_id) t LIMIT 10

results.question: 医药主题基金的持仓市值是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '医药主题基金' LIMIT 10

results.question: 有持仓记录的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_holding) LIMIT 10

results.question: 有交易记录的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade) LIMIT 10

results.question: 有资金流出记录的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_cashflow f ON c.cust_id = f.cust_id WHERE f.flow_type = '流出' AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_cashflow) LIMIT 10

results.question: 主办关系的客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN service_relation s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.is_primary = 1 LIMIT 10

results.question: 各客群标签的客户数分布
results.sql: SELECT c.cust_tag AS 客群标签, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c GROUP BY c.cust_tag ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 2 组）

results.question: 各营业部的客户数分布
results.sql: SELECT c.branch AS 营业部, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c GROUP BY c.branch ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各风险等级的客户数分布
results.sql: SELECT c.risk_level AS 风险等级, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c GROUP BY c.risk_level ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各产品类型的持仓市值
results.sql: SELECT p.prod_type AS 产品类型, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_type ORDER BY 持仓市值合计 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各客户经理名下的客户数（前 10 名）
results.sql: SELECT m.mgr_name AS 客户经理, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN service_relation s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id JOIN mgr_info m ON s.mgr_id = m.mgr_id GROUP BY m.mgr_name ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 10
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 10 组）

results.question: 各产品的持仓客户数与持仓市值
results.sql: SELECT p.prod_name AS 产品, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_name ORDER BY 持仓市值合计 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 20 组）

results.question: 各渠道的客户数分布
results.sql: SELECT c.channel AS 渠道, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 3 组）

results.question: 持有科技成长组合且总资产超过 500 万的高净值客户有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' AND p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' AND a.total_asset >= 5000000 LIMIT 10

results.question: 各风险等级客户的平均持仓市值
results.sql: SELECT c.risk_level AS 风险等级, AVG(h.market_value) AS 平均持仓市值 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.risk_level ORDER BY 平均持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 沉默客户中持有高风险产品（R4 及以上）的有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.risk_level >= 4 AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_cashflow WHERE flow_type = '流入' AND flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) LIMIT 10

results.question: 各客群标签的平均总资产与平均持仓市值
results.sql: SELECT t.d0 AS 客群标签, AVG(t.m0) AS 平均持仓市值, AVG(t.m1) AS 平均总资产 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS cust_id, c.cust_tag AS d0, SUM(h.market_value) AS m0, (SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) FROM cust_asset a WHERE a.cust_id = c.cust_id) AS m1 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_tag) t GROUP BY t.d0 ORDER BY 平均持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 2 组）

results.question: 持有新能源主题基金的高净值客户总资产合计是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.m0) AS 总资产合计 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS cust_id, (SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) FROM cust_asset a WHERE a.cust_id = c.cust_id) AS m0 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' AND p.prod_name = '新能源主题基金' GROUP BY c.cust_id) t LIMIT 10

results.question: C5 客户持有 R5 产品的持仓市值合计
results.sql: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE c.risk_level = 'C5' AND p.risk_level = 5 LIMIT 10

results.question: 各营业部近 180 日的交易金额合计
results.sql: SELECT c.branch AS 营业部, SUM(t.trade_amount) AS 交易金额 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_trade t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-180 day') GROUP BY c.branch ORDER BY 交易金额 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各客户画像的持仓市值与客户数
results.sql: SELECT c.archetype AS 客户画像, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.archetype ORDER BY 持仓市值合计 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各风险等级客户的人均资产
results.sql: SELECT c.risk_level AS 风险等级, SUM(a.total_asset) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.cust_id) AS 人均资产 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id GROUP BY c.risk_level ORDER BY 人均资产 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各产品风险等级下持仓客户的平均收益率
results.sql: SELECT p.risk_level AS 产品风险等级, AVG(h.profit_ratio) AS 平均收益率 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.risk_level ORDER BY 平均收益率 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 5 组）

results.question: 各渠道客户的近 180 日净流入合计
results.sql: SELECT c.channel AS 渠道, SUM(CASE WHEN f.flow_type = '流入' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END) AS 净流入 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_cashflow f ON c.cust_id = f.cust_id WHERE f.flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-180 day') GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY 净流入 DESC LIMIT 100
results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 3 组）

results.question: 各客群标签客户的近 180 日交易笔数

results.reason: 分组全部一致（共 2 组）

results.question: 持有医药主题基金的客户中，C4 及以上风险等级的有多少人
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE c.risk_level IN ('C4', 'C5') AND p.prod_name = '医药主题基金' LIMIT 10

results.question: 各营业部的持仓市值与客户数
results.sql: SELECT c.branch AS 营业部, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.branch ORDER BY 持仓市值合计 DESC LIMIT 100
